fusions.name: Bars Come Down
fusions.desc: Slams bars down on every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, stuns them for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Inescapable] for 8 seconds, unable to teleport away.

fusions.name: Prod the Penned
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Baited Door
fusions.desc: Sets a trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage and is left [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Gets Out
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike gains 15% critical chance. Once every 6 seconds.
